g.title: J1
g.text: box header, mates with Toyota A plug X3

Harness type assumed Toyota A with box v3, not read off the parts (DQ-211 C). Lines show the switched and sensed nets only; pins marked 'to J3' are plain PCB nets. A loopback in the plug adds R6 (3-5) or R8 (13-15).

g.title: U1
g.text: SPDT analog switch on CAN_H; V+ = VL = VIN
IN low = COM to NC (stock path). IN high = COM to NO (camera to terminated stub). Ratings unconfirmed (DFM-ACT-015).

g.title: U2
g.text: SPDT analog switch on CAN_L; V+ = VL = VIN
IN low = COM to NC (stock path). IN high = COM to NO (car to terminated stub). Ratings unconfirmed (DFM-ACT-015).

g.title: Q6
g.text: Q6 DMN3200U-7 with R1, R4, R5
IGN_12 on the gate (R4/R5 1 k divider) pulls SBU2 low through R1 1 k (HB-06).

g.title: D1
g.text: Box VIN also from comma power J2 pin 4 (HB-03).

g.title: J3
g.text: OBD-C receptacle (USB-C), box side; CC1 CC2 and D+ D- not connected

g.title: R2/R3
g.text: 2 x 120 ohm in series, SBU1 to GND
Release default and orientation load (HB-02, HB-07). Open = IN floats (F-03).

g.title: J2
g.text: comma power (optional accessory; use in the reference configuration not recorded, OI-W-5)
